title: Reset a VPN password
body: Employees can reset VPN passwords through the self-service identity portal.
steps: Approve the MFA prompt on your registered device.
Create a new password and wait five minutes before signing in to VPN.

title: Fix Wi-Fi connection issues
body: Most Wi-Fi issues are resolved by renewing the device network profile.
steps: Reconnect to CorpNet using your company email and password.
If the issue continues, create a ticket with your laptop asset tag.

title: Set up email on a mobile phone
body: Company email is supported through the Outlook mobile app.
steps: Install the Outlook app from the official app store.
Sign in with your company email.
Allow the required device management policy.
